indication_area: Infectious disease (acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections)
geography: U.S. (Durata's product revenue, all U.S.; Allergan plc's U.S. General Medicine Dalvance figure)

approval_evidence.quote: 05/23/2014 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity PRIORITY (NDA 021883, DALVANCE DALBAVANCIN)

launch_evidence.quote: The increase of $2.9 million is due to costs associated with the third quarter 2014 launch of Dalvance.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the launch quarter (Q3 2014; Durata's Q3 2014 10-Q prints its first product revenue).

unreported_quarters.2014Q4: Ownership change Durata Therapeutics to Actavis plc; no full-quarter figure is published. Actavis plc completed the Durata acquisition on November 17, 2014 (Actavis Form 10-K for 2014, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000119312515052898/d842874d10k.htm: 'On November 17, 2014, Actavis plc completed the Durata acquisition'); Durata's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for September 30, 2014 (its filings end 2014-12-12, data.sec.gov/submissions CIK 1544116), and Actavis's Q4 2014 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578845/000114420415010486/v401917_ex99-1.htm) prints no Dalvance row; Allergan plc's recast segment table (8-K 2016-10-06) begins with 2015Q1.

series_end_reason: Allergan plc's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020 (filed 2020-05-07); AbbVie completed the acquisition on May 8, 2020 and Allergan filed Form 15-12B on 2020-05-21. None of AbbVie's 177 earnings-related 8-K exhibits filed 2020-07-29 to 2026-11 (items 2.02, 7.01 or 9.01; every exhibit text searched, 10-Qs not searched) contains the word 'Dalvance', so no issuer prints the product's line after 2020Q1.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms) for CIK 1544116 (Durata), CIK 1578845 (Actavis/Allergan plc) and CIK 1551152 (AbbVie) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched Durata's 2014 8-K exhibits and 10-Q/10-K documents, every Allergan plc earnings 8-K exhibit and 10-Q/10-K 2014-07 to 2020-06, and every AbbVie earnings 8-K exhibit 2020-07 to 2026-11.

Allergan plc prints Dalvance in its own releases from 2016Q2; 2015Q1-2016Q1 are read from the US General Medicine table of the recast 8-K of 2016-10-06, whose 2016Q2 column (10.2) equals the Q2 2016 release figure. From 2016Q4 the release table has U.S. Specialized / U.S. General Medicine / International (/ Corporate) / Total columns and the U.S. General Medicine figure is recorded so that the series stays U.S. only.
